messages:
alex_s: @deal-desk quick ask — Medix Health (healthcare SaaS) is asking for a bespoke rate to move from POC -> prod. They require Private (VPC) + Dedicated 4xA100 pool + KMS/BYOK. POC scope is 6 weeks, target prod commit 12 months. List price for that config is ~$40k/mo (USD) -> ~$480k ARR. Customer says they'll go if we can do ~40% off list. Any objections?

maria_dd: got it. can you drop the exact list line items and confirm ARR math? also need commercial rationale for 40% (competitor benchmark / case study / references).

alex_s: line items: Dedicated infra 4xA100 = $28k/mo, Private control plane + infra ops = $8k/mo, support SLA + compliance add-on = $4k/mo. total = $40k/mo. ARR = $480k. Rationale: competitor quoted ~25% off but without BYOK and no SOC2 attestation. Medix says 40% needed to match their procurement band and internal budget for POC -> prod. They also asked about a short-term trial discount if we can't reach 40% upfront.

tara_ps: technical presales note — private + BYOK + dedicated changes ops profile. BYOK requires integration work and an HSM/KMS seat (one-time setup). That adds cost/time. For committed pricing we typically allow up to 30% on a 12mo commit. 40% is out of box for 12mo unless we get a larger commit or marketing value. For 40% we'd want either 18mo commit or an upfront payment covering first 6 months. Also need to schedule a deep-dive to scope the BYOK work (I can do Mon 10am PT).

joyce_finance: finance: discount matrix — 30% approval is OK at director level for >=$300k ARR. >30% and <=40% requires VP Rev sign-off. >40% requires CFO + commercial ops. We need gross margin impact calc and payment terms (prepay? net30?). If they prepay 12mo we can be flexible.

sam_legal: legal: BYOK + private deployment are fine but require standard security addendum + KMS SLA clauses. We should avoid custom indemnity. If they want a custom SLA (penalties), route through legal and get buy-in from ops. Also verify they can accept our standard DPA.

deal-desk-bot: /request-deal --id=1765327890 --account=MedixHealth --list=480000 --requested_discount=40 --commit_months=12 --extras="Private,VPC,BYOK,Dedicated-4xA100"

maria_dd: thanks. proposal from deal desk: counter to customer: 35% off list with 12mo commit + case study + prepay first 6 months (or 38% if they prepay full 12mo). We can include a 6-week POC credit (one-time) to reduce their POC risk. That preserves margin and gives customer runway.

alex_s: customer likely to accept 38% with case study + full prepay. I'll push for 38% first, ask for legal and finance to confirm BYOK fees. Also they'll accept a short-term trial credit.

tara_ps: confirm I'll scope BYOK effort in the tech call and estimate one-time integration fee (~$20k) that can be added to the deal or absorbed depending on discount.

joyce_finance: flagging to @eric_vp for >30% approval. please include the final ARR, proposed discount, prepay terms and expected cash timing.

eric_vp: saw the thread — I can approve up to 38% if we get a signed case study + $400k minimum committed ARR + prepay of at least 6 months. If they won't prepay, I'm inclined to cap at 35%. Please push those terms and send me the signed LOI when ready.

alex_s: thanks @eric_vp — I'll present counter: 38% with case study + 6mo prepay (or 35% net30). setting tech call Mon 10am PT with @tara_ps. I'll update when I have a firm yes. :thumbsup:
